_doc: Base-animal catalog (SPEC_PET_DESIGNER_PLATFORM §4.2). Master index of curated base animals + breeds. Each entry pins a `motion_profile` key at the MOST SPECIFIC AUTHORED level (§4.2): a breed carries its own key ONLY when a level-1 file exists in the motion registry; otherwise it inherits the animal row's key. `themed_page` names the /design/<slug> route (null = NO landing tile; the page is still reachable by direct URL and the breed falls back to General). A guard test (tests/test_animal_catalog.py) asserts every pinned `motion_profile` key resolves in the motion registry and every base.png exists.
_LAUNCH_GATE: SAFETY LEVER (§4.5, Item 1e): the base.png files are still PLACEHOLDERS pending human curation, so `themed_page` is null on every animal — the landing page (which filters tiles on themed_page) shows NO Cat/Dog tiles, so users can never see placeholder heroes. Real bases are being staged under _candidates/ by generate_candidates.py; the reviewer promotes the winners with promote_candidate.py, THEN restores each animal's `themed_page` to its `_themed_page_when_curated` value (a one-line edit) to light up the tiles. General covers every breed meanwhile. Guard test stays green throughout (it does not check themed_page).
